summary: A two branch aesthetics clinic appears to lose bookings to dead menu items, a demo form label and conflicting hours.

findings.problem: The Services, Injectables, Beauty Treatments and Body Treatments menu items appear to link to #, and the booking section appears to be headed Contact Form Demo.
findings.cost: Patients cannot browse treatments, and a demo label makes the form look untested.
findings.fix: Working menu pages and a clean, tested booking form.

findings.problem: The footer appears to show two different hours side by side, 10:00 AM to 09:00 PM and 11:00 AM to 1:30 AM, and the Ramadan block says 6 days while listing 7.
findings.cost: Patients may arrive when you are closed.
findings.fix: One verified hours table per branch.

findings.problem: The same doctor appears to be spelled several ways, such as Dr. Mohamed Amir, Dr. Mohamed Ameer and Dr. Mohammed ameen.
findings.cost: Inconsistent names weaken trust in a medical brand.
findings.fix: One correct name and credentials per doctor.

findings.problem: The footer appears to show 2023 as the copyright year, and a dummy.png placeholder image appears in the hero.
findings.cost: Old dates and placeholder images make the clinic look neglected.
findings.fix: Current dates and real hero photos.
